title: Caacay addat tan tutucto
intro: ambullee waytam kee ambullee waytam ittat axawah tan numma cubbus, atu gersiimih innah tan amoytiini sorkocô baxat tan muucih foocal solta. Ta rooci qaadik yan gufnek iroh tan ixxiga leeh, gersi mari dubuk fayramisam duuda caylitte amrisa. uxih, walah caylale num qunxa gineenit rammitle, kee numma elle raqtam uddur fan qellittam bictah. Ta muuci dabaanitteh addat qagaaqagitak geytimam miyyaay?
clues: Anu yok lakal num alle waa amoytiinu yomcowwe.
Anu kiciyyo xaleenak ixxigaa kee wale naggaareh.
Caacay yi amrih gubat suge, yi amriik ugutak anu faxah an ikke gexak suge.
Anu kimmir yab cedam duudah, kee oson yi qandeh addat ayfaf yeceen.
Anu qunxa kimbiro xaagu hirge malika wagittaamal ayro yassakaxxe.
Yi raba ardi gino yi caxxa takmem fan uqrat sugteeh, tohuk lakal dubuk jinni maqna lem aaxaguk sugeenim cede.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Kay raba jinnik qelliseh suge kay catot yakmem fan.
outcome.answer: Kay raba jinnik qelliseh suge kay catot yakmem fan.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
